## Summary
Adds `compute_weight(mass, gravity=9.81)` to the drone dynamics helpers and covers default gravity, custom gravity, and negative mass validation.

## Validation
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_dynamics.py -q`
- `.venv/bin/ruff check libs/ tests/`
- `.venv/bin/black --check libs/ tests/`
- `.venv/bin/mypy libs/`
title: [codex] add compute_weight helper
